name: What factors influence the total cost of a shower tile project?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the total cost of a shower tile project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shower tile installation costs depend on shower dimensions, demolition scope, sub-trade plumbing needs, and material selections like standard ceramic versus imported marble. Basic wall and floor retiling with standard subway tile costs significantly less than custom designs with integrated benches, recessed niches, and complex patterns. Additionally, if tearing out old tile reveals rotten framing or rusted plumbing valves, repair costs will increase. Working directly with a hands-on general contractor who handles framing, drywall, and tiling in-house helps keep project overhead controlled.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on shower dimensions, demolition needs, tile materials, custom features like benches or niches, and any plumbing or framing repairs behind the walls.
